user.title: Configure Microlife IdeaBus
user.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC address of your Microlife medical device (Monitor, Scale, Thermometer, or Oximeter). Ensure the device is powered on and in pairing mode.

abort.already_configured: This Microlife device is already configured.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the device.

tag_measurement.name: Assign User Tag to Record
tag_measurement.description: Overrides or assigns a custom user name tag to a historical record using a timestamp.

datetime.name: Record Timestamp
datetime.description: Exact time of the record from the archive attribute table.

user_tag.name: Real User Name

export_history.description: Filters measurements by user name and saves them into a CSV or TXT file inside www folder.

user_name.description: Target user name for data extraction.

format.name: Document Format
format.description: Select target output extension format (TXT or CSV).

end_date.name: Limit End Date

sync_time.description: Forces Home Assistant server system clock to overwrite the internal clock of Microlife device.
